svg.title: Validated frame commit and clock-domain crossing
svg.desc: Complete received frames pass FCS and protocol checks before atomic commitment to a dual-clock FIFO. The conversion clock drives group retirement independently of packet arrival. Pointer synchronisation and reset constraints require engineering review.
